eyebrow: It looks like text. It isn't.
caption: Real, queryable properties exist whether or not they show as a column.
Converts to display-only formatting data — put Format-* last in a pipeline.

code:
# Fragile: column widths shift as data changes
Get-Process | Format-Table Name, CPU | Out-String

# Reliable: reads the real property
Get-Process | Select-Object Name, CPU
caption: Parsing printed text breaks silently. Selecting the property doesn't.
